cards.name: The Spires of Zephorion Prime

effects.printed_clause: (This card is always treated as an "Eldora" card.)
effects.lua_implementation: The card’s archetype/set metadata supplies 0x0738; listed_series records the relation, paralleling official always-treated-as cards whose set identity is database-backed.

official_references.official_effect_text:
(This card is always treated as an "Elemental HERO" [b]and[/b] "Favorite" card.)
[b]Cannot[/b] be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand or GY) by banishing 1 "Elemental HERO" Fusion Monster or 1 "Winged Kuriboh" from your hand, face-up field, or GY. [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Winged Kuriboh LV6" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. [b]When[/b] an opponent's monster declares an attack, or your opponent activates a monster effect on the field ([b]Quick Effect[/b]): [b]You can[/b] Tribute this card; [b]destroy[/b] that 1 monster, [b]and if you do[/b], inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original ATK.

effects.printed_clause: This card is also treated as "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" while it is face-up on the field or in your GY.
effects.lua_implementation: A ranged single EFFECT_ADD_CODE applies the exact Eldora code in LOCATION_ONFIELD+LOCATION_GRAVE.

official_references.official_effect_text:
(This card is [b]also[/b] always treated as "Legendary Dragon Timaeus".)
[b]Target[/b] 1 "Dark Magician" monster you control; Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck that mentions that monster on the field as material, using it as the Fusion Material. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "The Eye of Timaeus" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: When this card is activated: Activate 1 "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" from your Deck, or, if it is already face-up on your field, add 1 monster from your Deck to your hand that lists "Eldora" in its text.
effects.lua_implementation: target/operation choose between a Deck exact-code Field Spell with activatable activation effect or listed monster search; activation branch replaces the Field Zone card, moves the new Field Spell, consumes its activation count/cost and raises the activation event. Eldora’s own activation has no target/operation.

official_references.matched_structure: activate a Field Spell directly from Deck
official_references.official_effect_text: Take 1 Field Spell from your Deck, [b]and[/b] either activate it or add it to your hand.

Reveal 1 Fusion Monster in your Extra Deck [b]and[/b] Special Summon, from your hand or Deck, 1 of the Fusion Materials whose name is mentioned on that monster, [b]also[/b] you [b]cannot[/b] Special Summon from the Extra Deck, except Fusion Monsters, the turn you activate this card. [b]You can[/b] only activate 1 "Fusion Deployment" [b]per turn[/b].

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent's card effect that would destroy your monster resolves, you can destroy this card you control.
effects.lua_implementation: e3 now triggers on EVENT_CHAIN_SOLVED for an opponent's effect whose CATEGORY_DESTROY operation group contains a monster currently or previously controlled in the Monster Zone, then destroys only this face-up Spell.

official_references.matched_structure: EVENT_CHAIN_SOLVED continuous processing after the activating effect resolves

effects.issue: Fixed: removed the unprinted destruction replacement. The threatened monster is no longer protected; this card is destroyed only after the qualifying opponent effect resolves.

cards.review_note: Independently reconciled against full printed text, canonical Lua, and the cited individual official Omega scripts/database rows.
